# Daly & Clemente

> A Pennsylvania-based personal injury and estate law firm providing comprehensive legal representation for accident victims, medical malpractice claims, and estate planning matters.

Daly & Clemente is a full-service law firm with offices in King of Prussia and Phoenixville, Pennsylvania, serving clients throughout Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and the Delaware Valley. The firm specializes in personal injury litigation, workers' compensation, and estate planning with a team of experienced attorneys recognized by Super Lawyers and the National Trial Lawyers.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Estate Planning & Probate
